name: Paul Atreides
aliases: Muad'Dib; Usul; Kwisatz Haderach; the Preacher (later)
role: Heir who becomes messiah-emperor; his jihad and prescience define the saga.
relationships: Son of Leto I & Jessica; partner of Chani; husband (in name) of Irulan; father of Leto II & Ghanima; brother of Alia
abilities: Bene Gesserit training, Mentat training, prescience, Fremen fighting, worm riding
book_fate: Blinded (Messiah), walks into desert; returns as the blind Preacher; killed in Arrakeen (Children of Dune)
adaptation_notes: 2021/2024 films: Chani rejects his jihad (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC). 1984 film: makes it rain, 'weirding modules'. Part Three (2026) adapts Messiah.
visual_brief: Slight, dark-haired, grey-green eyes turning full blue-in-blue (spice); posture of trained stillness; Fremen stillsuit with Atreides hawk motif later replaced by Imperial black-and-green
verify: Exact age at Messiah; wording of the Preacher's death

name: Duke Leto Atreides I
role: Honourable duke lured into the Arrakis trap by the Emperor and Harkonnens.
relationships: Partner of Jessica; father of Paul; liege of Duncan, Gurney, Thufir
abilities: Leadership, loyalty of troops ('the Atreides form')
book_fate: Dies after biting a poison-gas tooth planted by Yueh, killing Piter de Vries but not the Baron
adaptation_notes: 2021 film keeps the tooth attempt. 1984 film similar. EU: Prelude backstory (bullfighting father Paulus).
visual_brief: Mature, weathered naval aristocrat; close-cropped dark beard; dark uniform with green accents and hawk signet

name: Lady Jessica
role: Bene Gesserit concubine who broke orders by bearing a son; becomes Fremen Reverend Mother.
relationships: Partner of Leto I; mother of Paul & Alia; secret daughter of Baron Harkonnen
abilities: Voice, prana-bindu control, truthsense, Other Memory after the Water of Life
book_fate: Returns to Caladan; reappears in Children of Dune; death date from EU/secondary sources
adaptation_notes: Part Two: facial tattoos and a more overtly manipulative zealot framing (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC). Mohiam as her mother = EU.
visual_brief: Tall, auburn-bronze hair, composed ivory face; flowing Bene Gesserit robes; later Fremen aba with water rings

name: Alia Atreides
aliases: St. Alia of the Knife; Abomination
role: Pre-born child with full ancestral memory; later regent possessed by the Baron.
relationships: Daughter of Leto I & Jessica; sister of Paul; wife of Duncan (Hayt)
abilities: Ancestral memory from birth, Bene Gesserit powers
book_fate: Book: kills the Baron with a gom jabbar as a child; possessed by the Baron's memory; leaps to her death (Children of Dune)
adaptation_notes: Part Two: unborn throughout (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC). 1984: child kills the Baron. Part Three (2026) will show adult Alia.
visual_brief: Unsettlingly composed child with adult eyes; later a striking regent in Fremen-Imperial black robes

name: Chani
role: Fremen fighter; Paul's beloved and true partner.
relationships: Daughter of Liet-Kynes; partner of Paul; mother of Leto (died infant), Leto II & Ghanima
abilities: Fremen survival and combat, Sayyadina rites
book_fate: Dies in childbirth (Messiah), her pregnancy disrupted by Irulan's contraceptives
adaptation_notes: Part Two: rejects the prophecy and walks away (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC). Part Three (2026) adapts her Messiah arc.
visual_brief: Wiry, sun-dark Fremen woman, blue-in-blue eyes, dark hair bound; worn stillsuit, nose plugs, water-ring necklace

name: Baron Vladimir Harkonnen
role: Grossly obese, suspensor-borne schemer who destroys the Atreides.
relationships: Grandfather of Paul (secret); uncle of Rabban & Feyd-Rautha; employer of Piter de Vries
book_fate: Killed by Alia's gom jabbar (book); returns as a memory possessing Alia (Children)
adaptation_notes: Part Two: killed by Paul (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC). 1984: grotesque sores, flying. 2021/2024: bald, monumental.
visual_brief: Original design: enormous mass held aloft on suspensor belts, pale heavy face, small dark eyes, layered black-and-blue silks

name: Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen
role: Baron's chosen heir; gladiator; Bene Gesserit breeding target.
relationships: Nephew of the Baron; brother of Rabban
book_fate: Killed by Paul in single combat
adaptation_notes: Part Two: albino, black-sun arena (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC visual). 1984: winged codpiece.
visual_brief: Lithe young duellist, cold smile; arena harness in Harkonnen black

name: Glossu Rabban
role: Brutal governor of Arrakis used to make Feyd look like a saviour.
relationships: Nephew of the Baron; brother of Feyd
book_fate: Not dramatised in detail on the page after Paul's victory
adaptation_notes: Part Two: killed by Gurney Halleck (FILM ADAPTATION).
visual_brief: Bull-necked enforcer, scarred knuckles, heavy Harkonnen armour

name: Duncan Idaho
affiliation: House Atreides → Leto II → Bene Gesserit
homeworld: Giedi Prime (escaped as a child) / Ginaz (EU)
era: Original life d. 10191 AG; gholas to c. 15240+
role: Swordmaster whose endlessly reborn gholas span 5,000 years.
relationships: Loyal to Paul and Leto I; husband of Alia (as Hayt); gholas serve Leto II; later Murbella's lover
abilities: Swordmaster; ghola memory recovery; later Mentat abilities
book_fate: Dies protecting Paul (Dune); gholas recur through Chapterhouse; escapes on the no-ship
adaptation_notes: 1984/2021: dies defending Paul. Part Three (2026) introduces Hayt.
visual_brief: Curly black hair (consistent across all gholas), compact powerful swordsman; costume shifts per era

name: Gurney Halleck
role: Warrior-troubadour; inkvine scar; smuggler interlude.
book_fate: Survives; later serves Jessica (Children of Dune)
visual_brief: Lumpy, ugly-strong face with an inkvine-whip scar along the jaw; nine-string baliset

name: Thufir Hawat
role: Old Mentat master of assassins.
book_fate: Captured, poisoned (residual poison); dies refusing the Baron's order to kill Paul
adaptation_notes: Villeneuve films: does not appear in Part Two; his book arc is unadapted (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC). 1984: sapho juice-stained lips, milking a cat.
visual_brief: Elderly, lean, red-stained lips from sapho juice (book detail)

name: Dr. Wellington Yueh
role: Suk doctor with 'Imperial Conditioning' who betrays the Atreides to save his wife Wanna.
relationships: Wife Wanna held by the Harkonnens
book_fate: Killed by the Baron (or Piter) after betrayal
visual_brief: Diamond tattoo of the Suk on the forehead; long moustache ringed in silver (book detail)

name: Liet-Kynes
role: Imperial planetologist secretly leading the Fremen terraforming dream.
relationships: Son of Pardot Kynes; father of Chani
book_fate: Dies in the desert after Harkonnen abandonment, hallucinating his father; killed by spice blow
adaptation_notes: 2021 film: portrayed as a woman, dies summoning a worm (ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC).
visual_brief: Sun-browned scholar, beard, stillsuit under Imperial ecologist robes

name: Pardot Kynes
role: Father of the Arrakis terraforming plan.
adaptation_notes: Expanded heavily in Prelude to Dune (EU).
visual_brief: Visionary ecologist, wind-burned, field instruments

name: Stilgar
role: Naib who shelters Paul and becomes the first of his fanatics.
visual_brief: Bearded Fremen elder warrior, scarred stillsuit, maker hooks

name: Princess Irulan Corrino
role: Emperor's daughter, historian of Muad'Dib, wife in name only.
relationships: Daughter of Shaddam IV; wife of Paul
book_fate: Part of the Messiah conspiracy; raises Leto II and Ghanima
adaptation_notes: Part Two: first appearance onscreen as a political observer. Part Three (2026) role expands.
visual_brief: Regal blonde court princess, gold-and-silver Corrino gown, scholar's ink-stained fingers

name: Shaddam IV Corrino
role: Emperor who conspires against the Atreides and loses the throne.
relationships: Father of Irulan, Wensicia; friend of Fenring
visual_brief: Red-haired (book) aging emperor; grey Sardaukar burseg uniform at Arrakeen

name: Count Hasimir Fenring
role: Genetic eunuch and failed Kwisatz Haderach who refuses to kill Paul.
relationships: Friend of Shaddam; husband of Margot
visual_brief: Small, weasel-like man with large dark eyes

name: Lady Margot Fenring
role: Bene Gesserit agent; secures Feyd-Rautha's bloodline.
adaptation_notes: Part Two: appears; seduces Feyd (largely faithful).
visual_brief: Elegant silver-gold-haired court lady with veiled hood

name: Gaius Helen Mohiam
role: Administers the gom jabbar test; Messiah conspirator.
adaptation_notes: Films: veiled, fearsome. Part Three (2026) Messiah arc pending.
visual_brief: Aged, birdlike face, black aba with deep hood, gom jabbar needle

name: Piter de Vries
role: Twisted Mentat strategist of the Baron.
visual_brief: Gaunt, sapho-red lips, nervous elegance

name: Leto Atreides II
aliases: God Emperor; the Tyrant; the Worm Who Is God
role: Prescient son of Paul who merges with sandtrout and rules 3,500 years to force the Golden Path.
relationships: Twin of Ghanima; son of Paul & Chani; mentor-jailer of Duncan gholas; ancestor of Siona
abilities: Prescience; near-immortality; strength of the sandtrout skin
book_fate: Dies at the Idaho River bridge; body becomes sandtrout; pearls of awareness in every worm
adaptation_notes: Children of Dune miniseries (2003). Part Three (2026) introduces him as a child (Messiah).
visual_brief: Stage 1: dark-haired boy; Stage 2: human face in a silver-grey worm body ~7m long (book), carried on the Royal Cart

name: Ghanima Atreides
role: Leto's twin; ancestral memory; marries Farad'n.
visual_brief: Fierce Fremen girl, blue eyes, crysknife

name: Farad'n Corrino
role: Corrino heir who becomes Leto II's royal scribe.
relationships: Son of Wensicia; husband of Ghanima
visual_brief: Scholarly young prince in Corrino gold

name: Wensicia Corrino
role: Plots the twins' assassination with Laza tigers.
relationships: Daughter of Shaddam; mother of Farad'n
visual_brief: Sharp Corrino matriarch

name: Scytale
role: Shape-shifting conspirator in Messiah.
book_fate: Killed by Paul (using Leto II's vision) after offering a Chani ghola
adaptation_notes: Part Three (2026): cast (ADAPTATION pending). Note: a different Tleilaxu Master Scytale appears in Heretics/Chapterhouse.
visual_brief: Original design: featureless 'blank' rest face; shifting faces rendered with soft-focus morph

name: Bijaz
role: Tleilaxu dwarf who plants the trigger in Hayt.
visual_brief: Small, ancient-eyed dwarf

name: Edric
role: Guild Navigator in an orange-gas tank; hides the conspiracy from Paul's prescience.
visual_brief: Elongated fish-like humanoid in a tank of orange spice gas

name: Otheym
role: Dying Fedaykin who gives Paul the dwarf Bijaz and the names of traitors.
visual_brief: Wasted former warrior with sem-ttuta disease

name: Korba
role: Former Fedaykin turned high priest; conspirator.
visual_brief: Priestly Fremen in jewelled Qizara robes

name: Siona Atreides
role: Rebel invisible to prescience — the culmination of Leto's breeding.
relationships: Daughter of Moneo; partner of a Duncan ghola
book_fate: Survives; her line enables the Scattering
visual_brief: Athletic, fierce young rebel in desert gear

name: Moneo Atreides
role: Leto's loyal majordomo, once a rebel.
visual_brief: Grey-haired steward, careful posture

name: Hwi Noree
role: Ixian-designed ideal bride; the trap Leto knowingly accepts.
visual_brief: Serene, unnervingly perfect ambassador

name: Nayla
role: Fish Speaker loyal to Siona who fires the lasgun at the bridge.
visual_brief: Powerful woman soldier

name: Miles Teg
role: Mentat-general who develops impossible speed; dies holding Rakis.
relationships: Atreides descendant; protector of the Duncan ghola
book_fate: Dies during the Honored Matre destruction of Rakis; returns as a ghola (Chapterhouse)
visual_brief: Aged, tall commander, white hair, Atreides features

name: Darwi Odrade
role: Atreides-blooded Mother Superior who plans the merger with the Honored Matres.
relationships: Daughter of Teg; mentor of Murbella
book_fate: Killed during the Junction confrontation; Murbella then seizes leadership
visual_brief: Lean, dark-eyed Reverend Mother

name: Sheeana Brugh
role: Rakian girl who can command sandworms.
visual_brief: Wiry desert girl, later robed Reverend Mother

name: Murbella
role: Honored Matre who becomes Bene Gesserit and unites both orders.
abilities: Honored Matre combat and sexual imprinting
visual_brief: Powerful green-eyed fighter; tight leotard + flowing cape (Matre style)

name: Alma Mavis Taraza
role: Mother Superior whose plan sacrifices Rakis.
book_fate: Dies in the attack on Rakis

name: Tylwyth Waff
role: Tleilaxu Master who reveals the hidden Islamic-Sufi faith of the Bene Tleilax.

name: Serena Butler
first_appearance: Legends of Dune: The Butlerian Jihad (2002)
role: Mother whose murdered infant ignites the Jihad (EU).
relationships: Mother of Manion; lover of Xavier Harkonnen
visual_brief: Original noblewoman in pale League robes

name: Erasmus
role: Independent robot fascinated by humanity; kills Serena's child.
visual_brief: Original: silvered flowmetal face, Renaissance robes

name: Omnius
role: Distributed AI ruling the Synchronized Worlds.
visual_brief: Abstract: networked light / spheres

name: Vorian Atreides
role: Son of the cymek Agamemnon; long-lived hero of the Jihad.
book_fate: Survives into the Great Schools era
adaptation_notes: Also appears in Prophecy-era EU books; TV status: not a lead.
visual_brief: Original weathered space admiral

name: Xavier Harkonnen
role: Heroic Harkonnen whose death is twisted by history.

name: Abulurd Harkonnen
first_appearance: Legends of Dune: The Battle of Corrin (2004)
role: Branded a coward at Corrin — origin of the feud (EU).

name: Norma Cenva
role: Mathematical genius who makes foldspace travel practical; first navigator (EU).
adaptation_notes: EU only; Herbert names Holtzman, not Cenva.

name: Raquella Berto-Anirul
first_appearance: Legends of Dune: The Battle of Corrin / Sisterhood of Dune
role: First Reverend Mother (EU).

name: Valya Harkonnen
role: Ambitious Harkonnen Sister who becomes Mother Superior.
adaptation_notes: Prophecy (TV) significantly reworks her (TELEVISION ADAPTATION vs EXPANDED novel).
visual_brief: Original: severe older Sister, black robes

name: Tula Harkonnen
role: Valya's sister; key to the TV story's secrets.

name: Desmond Hart
role: Mysterious soldier who claims to have survived a sandworm; TV-original.
visual_brief: Original: gaunt scarred soldier

name: Gilbertus Albans
role: Erasmus's ward, founder of the Mentat school (EU).
